verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents Volumes as persistent storage that survives instance destruction and can be reattached to new instances. Volumes are managed from a Storage page, and the CLI covers volume operations, so datasets and checkpoints can outlive a single rental. A community user wished persistent disks were easier to work with over time, which is a usability gripe rather than a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: no evidence that volumes are network-attached and usable across different host machines, no detail on attach/mount workflow or durability guarantees, and no independent hands-on corroboration that reattachment works.
